findings.description: This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so Terraform does not enforce encryption at rest for its contents. The bucket stores the customer-master object, increasing the risk that sensitive customer data is stored without an explicitly enforced encryption control.
This financial-data bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Financial objects are therefore not protected by an encryption-at-rest policy defined and enforced by this infrastructure.
This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, leaving stored operational data without an explicitly enforced encryption-at-rest control.
This bucket has no server-side encryption configuration. Enabling access logging and versioning does not encrypt the bucket's data at rest.
